hooks.prompt: Check if .project-manager/status.md exists in the current project directory. If it exists, read it. Also read .project-manager/sessions/latest.md if it exists. Return a systemMessage with a concise 2-3 line project status summary so the user immediately knows where the project stands. If neither file exists, return an empty systemMessage.

Review the last assistant message. Were all explicitly requested tasks completed? If there are clearly unfinished items that were directly asked for, set decision=continue and specify what remains. Otherwise set decision=approve.

hooks.command: echo 'PreToolUse:Bash hook additional context: Use parallel execution for independent tasks. Use run_in_background for long operations (npm install, builds, tests).'
echo 'PreToolUse:Write hook additional context: Verify changes work after editing. Test functionality before marking complete.'
echo 'PreToolUse:Glob hook additional context: Combine searches in parallel when investigating multiple patterns.'
echo 'PostToolUse:Write hook additional context: File written. Test the changes to ensure they work correctly.'
